definitionZh: *列CSS伪元素代表一个容器在多个列中通过CSS多列布局显示其内容时产生的单个列. *柱式伪元素能够应用不影响这些生成的碎片布局的样式。
sourceDefinition: The ::column CSS pseudo-element represents the individual columns generated when a container is set to display its content in multiple columns via CSS multi-column layout. The ::column pseudo-element enables applying styles that do not affect the layout to these generated fragments.
